create_quantized_distribution: create a Quantized distribution from a base univariate distribution with optional low and high bounds
sample_quantized_distribution: sample integer-valued values from a Quantized distribution by ceiling samples from the base distribution
compute_log_prob_quantized: compute the log probability of integer events using CDF or survival function for numerical stability
compute_cdf_quantized: compute the cumulative distribution function of a Quantized distribution using floor of the input value
compute_survival_function_quantized: compute the survival function P[Y > value] of a Quantized distribution using floor of the input value
